stem:
The diagram shows Vivaan holding a thick cardboard sheet between a bulb and a white screen. Light from the bulb is blocked by the cardboard before it reaches the screen.

Which claim about the shadow is correct?

options.text: A dark shadow forms on the screen because the cardboard blocks light from the bulb.
An object that blocks more light makes a lighter shadow on the screen.
The cardboard still casts a distinct shadow on the screen when the bulb is switched off.
Only opaque objects can form shadows; translucent and transparent objects cannot form any shadow.

teacher.key_rationale: A shadow is the dark region on the screen where the cardboard blocks light from the bulb. Blocking more light makes a darker shadow, not a lighter one; with the bulb off there is no distinct shadow; translucent objects can cast faint shadows.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote source lens diagram into bulb, cardboard, and screen.
